			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active

			DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_ab_s01_deadline_case

		}

			var:zg361_we_ab_s01_deadline_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ab_s01_relay_owner }
			save_scope_as = zg361_we_ab_s01_relay_subject
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ab_s01_relay_cycle value = var:zg361_we_ab_s01_deadline_cycle }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ab_s01_relay_case value = var:zg361_we_ab_s01_deadline_case }
